items.exampleEn: He put some mustard on his hot dog.
items.exampleZh: 他在熱狗上加了一些芥末醬。

items.exampleEn: The smell of bacon filled the kitchen.
items.exampleZh: 培根的香味充滿了廚房。

items.exampleEn: Wash the lettuce well before you make the salad.
items.exampleZh: 做沙拉之前要把萵苣洗乾淨。

items.exampleEn: A loaf of bread costs about two dollars here.
items.exampleZh: 這裡一條麵包大約兩美元。

items.exampleEn: Canned fish can last for years on the shelf.
items.exampleZh: 罐頭魚放在架上好幾年都不會壞。

items.exampleEn: Spinach is a dark green vegetable.
items.exampleZh: 菠菜是一種深綠色的蔬菜。

items.exampleEn: A cup of hot ginger tea warms me up in winter.
items.exampleZh: 冬天喝一杯熱薑茶讓我暖和起來。

items.sentenceEn: There is a loaf of bread in the kitchen.

items.audioEn: We're almost out of vegetables, but there is still a cabbage in the fridge.
items.audioZh: 我們的蔬菜快吃完了，不過冰箱裡還有一顆高麗菜。

items.sentenceEn: I'd like a bacon sandwich without mustard, please.
items.sentenceZh: 我要一份培根三明治，不要芥末醬，謝謝。

items.sentenceEn: Ginger gives the fish a nice flavor.
items.sentenceZh: 薑讓這道魚有很好的味道。

items.stemEn: She cut the ____ of bread into ten slices.
items.stemZh: 她把那條麵包切成十片。

items.stemEn: We keep some ____ food in the cupboard for emergencies.
items.stemZh: 我們在櫥櫃裡放一些罐頭食品以備不時之需。

items.passageEn: Mrs. Lin runs a small sandwich shop near a train station. Every morning, she buys fresh lettuce, spinach and cabbage at the market. Her most popular sandwich has bacon and a little mustard. She also bakes ten loaves of bread a day, and on cold days she puts ginger in her chicken soup. When fresh vegetables are expensive, she uses some canned ones. She works full-time, but she always takes a short rest after lunch.
items.passageZh: 林太太在火車站附近開了一家小三明治店。每天早上，她到市場買新鮮的萵苣、菠菜和高麗菜。她最受歡迎的三明治夾了培根和一點芥末醬。她每天還烤十條麵包，天冷時會在雞湯裡加薑。新鮮蔬菜貴的時候，她會用一些罐頭蔬菜。她是全職工作，但午餐後總會稍微休息一下。

questions.questionZh: 林太太最受歡迎的三明治夾了什麼？
新鮮蔬菜貴的時候，林太太怎麼做？
